title: MVP Implementation
description:
Implement Agent Session Viewer MVP: real-time JSONL viewing with <500ms latency.

## Epic Directory
All design materials are in devdocs/mvp/:
- design.md - Full architecture, protocols, edge cases
- implementation.md - Code patterns, snippets, implementation order
- tests.md - Comprehensive test specifications
- plan.md - Phase tracking and status
close_reason: MVP complete: all 7 phases done, 10 Go integration tests passing, 54ms latency

title: Phase 1: Server Foundation
description:
Create basic HTTP server with placeholder UI.

## What to build
- server/main.go with HTTP server on port 8080
- server/static/index.html (placeholder)
- GET /api/sessions returning {"sessions": []}

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 1: Server Foundation'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Server' for full API spec

## Validation
Can load http://localhost:8080 in browser and see HTML page.
close_reason: Server foundation complete - HTTP server, static HTML, /api/sessions endpoint working

title: Phase 2: Server WebSocket
description:
Add WebSocket handler and in-memory session storage.

## What to build
- WebSocket endpoint at /watch (gorilla/websocket)
- SessionStore with map[path]*Session
- Update /api/sessions to return stored sessions
- GET /api/sessions/{path} to return session content

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 2: Server WebSocket'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Server' for data structures and API

## Validation
Use wscat or similar to send a line message, verify it appears in /api/sessions response.
close_reason: WebSocket handler working, session storage implemented, API returns actual data

title: Phase 3: Watcher Core
description:
Build watcher that reads existing .jsonl files and sends to server.

## What to build
- watcher/main.go with CLI flags (--watch, --server)
- Recursive directory scan for .jsonl files
- Read files line-by-line, send via WebSocket
- FileState tracking (path, last line, last size)

## Dependencies
- github.com/gorilla/websocket

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 3: Watcher Core'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Watcher' for data structures

## Validation
Start server, start watcher on test-sessions/, verify /api/sessions shows the files.
close_reason: Watcher scans directory, reads .jsonl files, sends to server via WebSocket. Nested directories supported.

title: Phase 4: Live Updates
description:
Add fsnotify file watching and batching for live updates.

## What to build
- fsnotify integration for file change detection
- Read only new lines (seek to last position)
- 100ms batch ticker to collect and send lines
- Handle file truncation (reset to beginning)

## Dependencies
- github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 4: Live Updates' + 'Batching Implementation'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Watcher' for edge cases

## Validation
Append line to .jsonl file, verify it appears in /api/sessions within ~200ms.
close_reason: fsnotify integrated, file modifications detected, new lines sent to server, new files detected

title: Phase 5: Browser Live View
description:
Add SSE streaming and browser live updates.

## What to build
- GET /api/sessions/{path}/stream SSE endpoint
- Broadcast LineEvent to SSE clients when lines received
- SSE client in index.html (EventSource)
- Update UI when lines arrive

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 5: Browser Live View' + 'SSE Broadcasting'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Server → Browser (SSE)' for event format

## Validation
Open browser, watch a session, append to file, see update appear live.
close_reason: SSE endpoint working, browser receives live updates, auto-scroll implemented

title: Phase 6: Polish
description:
Polish UI and add error handling.

## What to build
- Auto-scroll (on by default, disable on scroll up, re-enable at bottom)
- Live indicators (green dot = active, gray = idle >5s)
- Error banners for connection failures
- Reconnection logic (watcher: exponential backoff; browser: retry SSE)

## References
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Phase 6: Polish'
- devdocs/mvp/design.md § 'Web UI' for UI layout, § 'Error Handling'

## Validation
- Kill server, verify watcher reconnects
- Scroll up, verify auto-scroll stops
- Full manual testing checklist in devdocs/mvp/implementation.md
close_reason: Added watcher reconnection with backoff, global SSE stream, buffer management, error handling

title: Phase 7: Testing
description:
Run comprehensive test suite and measure performance.

## What to do
- Run all tests from devdocs/mvp/tests.md
- Fix any failures
- Measure latency (target: <500ms file write → browser)
- Document any deviations from spec

## References
- devdocs/mvp/tests.md - Full test specifications
- devdocs/mvp/implementation.md § 'Performance Targets'

## Validation
All tests pass. Latency measured and documented. README updated if needed.
close_reason: All MVP tests passing: initial scan, live updates, file creation, content retrieval, latency 133ms
